decisions.subject: allowed-signers source and offline public-key custody
options_considered: owner-supplied existing offline Ed25519 public key with independently verified custody evidence
new Ed25519 key generated offline under a separately authorized custody ceremony
stand-local key generation or stand-resident private key
remain blocked
decisions.recommended_option: use an owner-selected offline Ed25519 public key; never create or store its private key on the stand
decisions.scientific_effect: none; this authenticates qualification authority and does not alter the experiment
decisions.compatibility_effect: public-key bytes, SSHSIG principal/namespace, fingerprint, allowed-signers bytes, and custody identity become authorization identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before allowed-signers artifact construction or stand setup
decisions.supersession_rule: new ADR, new artifact identities, independent review, and prospective acceptance; old evidence remains immutable

decisions.subject: literal operational release root
options_considered: owner-selected absolute content-addressed stand path verified against fresh prestate
mutable non-content-addressed path
infer a path from repository or runbook examples
remain blocked
decisions.recommended_option: select one absolute content-addressed stand path only after read-only prestate proves its parent, permissions, filesystem, and collision state
decisions.scientific_effect: none unless the selected bytes differ, which is forbidden
decisions.compatibility_effect: the literal root and every resolved controller/library path become setup and authorization identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before transfer/install or stand setup authorization
decisions.supersession_rule: new clean release/path decision and full prospective verification; never retarget an issued authorization

decisions.subject: literal secondary custody root
options_considered: owner-selected absolute root in a separately controlled non-stand custody domain
stand-local directory under the primary custody domain
infer the development repository or a temporary directory
remain blocked
decisions.recommended_option: select an absolute non-stand root controlled independently from the primary stand custody domain, with append-only receipt handling
decisions.scientific_effect: none; it protects qualification evidence availability and independence
decisions.compatibility_effect: literal custody root, controlling principal, transfer mechanism, and receipts become evidence identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before stand setup or any qualification artifact transfer
decisions.supersession_rule: new custody decision plus prospective access/receipt verification; prior artifacts and receipts remain immutable

decisions.subject: fresh read-only stand-prestate collection
options_considered: fixed argv-only read-only collector with canonical envelope, exit codes, stdout/stderr, and SHA-256
manual unstructured shell transcript
collector that creates, installs, fixes, or probes access
remain blocked
decisions.recommended_option: freeze and implement a fixed no-mutation collector, then authorize one exact read-only stand execution separately
evidence: ADR-0064 fail-closed access and quarantine boundary
decisions.scientific_effect: none; collected state is eligibility evidence and cannot fill scientific freeze values
decisions.compatibility_effect: collector version, exact argv, stand identity, UTC window, raw outputs, exit codes, and envelope hash become setup evidence
decisions.deadline_gate: before literal path selection and stand setup authorization
decisions.supersession_rule: new collector contract and fresh prospectively authorized evidence; stale evidence remains retained but ineligible

decisions.subject: actual allowed-signers artifact, hash, and Ed25519 fingerprint binding
options_considered: canonical artifact derived from the accepted offline public key and independently hash/fingerprint verified
accept a user-written fingerprint or unverified allowed-signers file
derive identity after installation on the stand
remain blocked
decisions.recommended_option: construct canonical allowed-signers bytes off-stand, record artifact ID and SHA-256, derive the Ed25519 fingerprint independently, and require byte equality after install
decisions.scientific_effect: none; it binds authorization authenticity without changing measurement behavior
decisions.compatibility_effect: canonical file bytes, artifact ID, SHA-256, key fingerprint, principal, namespace, and verification tool become authorization identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before trust-anchor installation or signed Q15-R preparation
decisions.supersession_rule: key rotation requires a new ADR, new artifact/hash/fingerprint, new signatures, and prospective acceptance

external_input_contracts.name: @ALLOWED_SIGNERS_SOURCE@
required_evidence: independent review artifact ID and SHA-256

external_input_contracts.name: @SECONDARY_CUSTODY_ROOT@
required_evidence: custody-domain ID distinct from the stand

external_input_contracts.name: ACTUAL_ALLOWED_SIGNERS_ARTIFACT_ID_SHA256_AND_ED25519_FINGERPRINT
required_evidence: independent verification artifact ID and SHA-256

required_observations: four principal and common-group existence and numeric IDs
accepted primary paths and trust-anchor destination lstat metadata without following symlinks
candidate parent filesystem and mount identity without selecting an operational release root
required literal executable presence and version where already installed
free-space observation only, not a capacity approval
raw stdout, stderr, and exit status for every fixed argv
forbidden_operations: key creation, import, copy, or fingerprint invention
calibration, pilot, measurement, or confirmatory execution
artifact_requirements: per-command start/end UTC, stdout, stderr, and exit code

future_gates.scope: accept D-066 through D-070 acquisition methods and authorize repository-local collector/validator implementation only
one exact read-only stand-prestate collection after clean release and explicit authorization
owner-selected offline signer/key and allowed-signers artifact custody action
